now: I study philosophy and political economy, write about public discourse, and build tools for research and practical workflows.

experience.title: Epistemology & philosophy of science
experience.description: I study how beliefs can be tested and revised. I compare Popper and Feyerabend on scientific method, and trace disputes over empiricism, falsifiability, and fallibilism.

experience.title: Political economy & social coordination
experience.description: I read Hayek on dispersed knowledge, prices, and complex social phenomena, and explore how people coordinate when each has only part of the information.

experience.title: THESUS · Supervised browsing
experience.description: Published a browser workspace with human review, manual takeover, and session replay. Tested the handoff through a guided demo.

experience.title: Data OSINT & ASTIG · Research tools
experience.description: Developed a terminal interface for research and a review workflow for versioned datasets. Built ASTIG separately to trace claims back to supplied evidence.

experience.title: 7erfa w Bricole · Marketplace prototype
experience.description: Studied the feasibility of a home services marketplace in Morocco. Built and tested booking, quotes, and operations workflows with fictional transactions.

experience.title: Portfolio & project dependencies
experience.description: Published this redesigned portfolio with editable content, a Substack feed, and a map that shows how my projects exchange evidence.

experience.title: Logic & foundations
experience.description: Read Tarski on truth and proof, studied Gödel’s incompleteness theorems, and explored formal reasoning and mathematical fallibility through logic exercises.

experience.title: Swarm Studio · Agent workflows
experience.description: Integrated local models and tested evidence exports into Support Studio for human review and the DIY Phone Gateway for planning.

experience.title: AEGIS-iPad · Offline evidence review
experience.description: Prototyped local model summaries that retain source references, and tested the software across Windows and Linux.

experience.title: Voice systems · Architecture research
experience.description: Compared architectures for real-time voice and Darija support. Documented provider tradeoffs, cost assumptions, and what a pilot would need to test.

experience.title: Social theory & historical change
experience.description: Studied the economic calculation debate and compared Hegel and Marx on historical change alongside critiques of historicism.

experience.title: Deceptive Discourse · Marqicci Take
experience.description: Published an essay on Aristotelian rhetoric, persuasion, and how claims gain credibility in public discourse.

experience.title: AI chat · Next.js starter experiment
experience.description: Explored Vercel’s AI Chatbot starter to see how a chat interface, streaming responses, and application data fit together.

experience.description: Published a small HTML and CSS site around a tea theme. It became the starting point for this portfolio.
